messages:
liao: Heads up — we started getting customer reports about delayed syncs. I noticed the incident channel did not page infra-oncall between 09:12 and 09:24. @incident-bot shows suppressed pages. Anyone on call?

sam: I got a couple of Slack alerts but no Pager pages. Wasn't sure if it was filtered by the bot. Which rotation?

liao: infra-oncall rotation. Root alert came at 09:11 (high 5xx rate on inference-gateway). It retriggered several times. PagerDuty shows the incident created, but no sms/push for that rotation.

maria: Paging logs from notify-proxy show a bunch of 403/401-ish responses to PagerDuty webhook. Grabbed last 20 lines: 
```
2026-02-17T09:12:03Z notify-proxy WARN webhook-signature-mismatch rotation=infra-oncall pd_request_id=abc123
2026-02-17T09:12:04Z notify-proxy ERROR pd-api 401 Unauthorized token_id=rot-xxxx
2026-02-17T09:13:11Z notify-proxy WARN backoff sleeping=60s reason=429
2026-02-17T09:14:09Z notify-proxy WARN webhook-signature-mismatch rotation=infra-oncall pd_request_id=def456
```

jia: signature-mismatch + 401 for the rotation token smells like the signing key rotated but the proxy/service didn't pick it up. We rotated keys last night for the pd webhook signing, right?

sam: Yes, ops rotated the webhook signing secret in PD at 03:00. There was a small note but I thought the proxy reads from secret manager automatically.

ops-bot: Automated note: secret/notify/pd-signing was rotated by ops-team at 2026-02-17T03:00Z (change-id: ch-7788).

maria: Looks like the notify-proxy only rereads on service restart. It didn't hot-reload. So new PD signatures fail verification -> webhook rejected -> incidentbot thinks this is a duplicate or invalid -> suppressed paging.

liao: That explains the suppressed pages. Customer impact: we saw a ~12m delay on remediation for a subset of customers in us-east because the on-call didn't get paged. SLO blips for request p95 were recorded.

sam: Immediate mitigation? Can we force a manual page and restart proxy?

jia: I'm restarting notify-proxy in us-east now. Will run config verify afterward.

incident-bot: System: suppression rule applied: incoming webhook pd_incident_id=PD-89012 matched suppression-rule=signature-mismatch, action=suppress (reason documented).

maria: While Jia restarts, we should manually escalate to infra-oncall via PagerDuty API so they get SMS/push. Use this curl to trigger escalate (manual step):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-89012/alerts" \
  -H "Accept: application/vnd.pagerduty+json;version=2" \
  -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED_MANUAL_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"incident": {"type": "incident_reference","id": "PD-89012"}}'
```

liao: done — I sent the manual escalation and pinged infra-oncall slack channel directly. Received ack from @sam (infra-oncall).

sam: Ack — looking into what caused 5xxs. Found a high GC stall in model-worker-3 reproducing with long tail. Opening a task to cycle that node.

jia: notify-proxy restart complete at 09:19. Verified signature verification logs: 
```
2026-02-17T09:19:21Z notify-proxy INFO loaded-signing-secret version=rot-2026-02-17-03
2026-02-17T09:19:22Z notify-proxy INFO webhook-verified pd_request_id=ghi789
```

ops-bot: Automated: service notify-proxy (us-east) restarted by jia at 2026-02-17T09:19:20Z (runbook: notify-proxy-restart).

maria: Confirmed PagerDuty is now receiving valid webhooks and incidentbot posted follow-ups for outstanding incidents. We still need to check if any handoffs were lost (channel automation that posts "oncall-handoff" messages).

liao: The oncall-handoff automation didn't post a handoff note for the PD incident because the bot's OAuth scope for channels:write was in flux during rotation. There's a separate check failing with 403 when trying to create the handoff message. Logs: `automation-service 403 forbidden createMessage rotation=infra-oncall`.

sam: So two separate failures: webhook signature mismatch suppressed incoming PD -> no page; and automation-service lacking correct scope prevented creating the in-channel handoff message. That compounded on-call confusion.

jia: For remediation: I'll add a post-rotation checklist so notify-proxy is restarted or hot-reloadable. Also add a health-check for webhook verification returning non-2xx -> alert to pagerduty-admin channel (so ops sees it before user impact).

maria: I'll file a follow-up to add a zero-downtime signing-key rotation pattern (double-write verification window) and update runbooks to include manual escalation commands.

liao: Customer impact assessment (preliminary): about ~40 customers saw delayed remediation windows, 3 customers had measurable SLO misses >5m. No data exfiltration, only delayed responses. I'll attach alert/query results to the ticket.

sam: Post-incident actions we should track:
- immediate: hotfix runbook + notify-proxy restart (done)
- short-term: add PD webhook verification health alert + automation-service scope audit
- medium: implement hot-reload for signing secrets or watch for secret changes + safer rotation process
- long-term: add end-to-end test for PD webhook + slack handoff automation in CI

incident-bot: System: incident PD-89012 marked as acknowledged by user infra-oncall at 2026-02-17T09:22Z.

liao: Agree. I'll create INC-1102 for the follow-ups and assign owners. Thanks everyone, closing thread but will add timeline to postmortem. :white_check_mark:

maria: Adding notes to the ticket now and will check for any straggler alerts.

sam: I'll include the GC mitigation steps in the postmortem (cycling model-worker-3).

jia: FYI — ops will re-run key rotation in a staged manner next time and coordinate with devs.

liao: Closing summary: root cause = signing-key rotation + notify-proxy hot-reload gap + missing automation scope -> suppressed pages & missing oncall-handoff -> delayed remediation. Resolved by manual escalate + restart. Follow-ups assigned.
